text: Landed (worker-1, 2026-09-04): adaptive-SF port in python/src/lichen/gradient.py — constants (SNR_UPGRADE_THRESHOLD=8, SNR_DOWNGRADE_THRESHOLD=0, UPGRADE_COUNT_THRESHOLD=3, DOWNGRADE_COUNT_THRESHOLD=2, DENSITY_UPGRADE_MAX=5, DEFAULT_SF=10, SF_MIN=7, SF_MAX=12, EMA_LOSS_THRESHOLD_FP=16384, LOAD_FACTOR_THRESHOLD_FP=52429 — names kept for the zrh2.8 test contract), GradientEntry sf fields (current_sf None=absent, snr_ewma, upgrade_count, downgrade_count), GradientTable.sf_update (EWMA (sample-avg)>>2, int8 clamp, counter maintenance, silent no-op on missing entry) and sf_select (6-step CCP-16 + floors a-d in order, returns None on missing entry, persists current_sf). PARITY: reviewer pass 1 found a real break — C lichen_gradient_update preserves sf state across accepted routing updates (gradient.c:158-181 save/restore) while Python's wholesale replace wiped it; fixed with the preserve block in update() (verified by a regression check: routing refresh keeps current_sf/snr_ewma/counters). Counter-wrap divergence (C uint8 wraps at 255 vs Python unbounded) filed as project-LICHEN-worker6-zhgy for the semantics decision. Cross-validated against the C test oracle lichen/tests/routing_dispatch/src/main.c:1119-1210 (density 10 stays / 11 -> 12; floors a: ewma -6 -> 12, b: -1 -> 11, c: density 11 from sf 7 -> 11; EWMA convergence 5x15 -> ewma 10 count 2; util>200 -> (12, False); load 60000 -> >=11) via /tmp scratch drive — all match. 92 existing gradient tests pass, mypy clean, ruff clean.
